verify_loop.retry: Red gate: fix the cause, commit, rerun per the rerun table
rules: One head: every gate runs on the same commit; the table's head must equal HEAD when the PR opens.
A red gate never restarts itself: fix the cause (root-cause when it is not obvious), commit, restart at gate 2.
Docs, config, copy-only and no-behavior-change diffs run a smaller gate set (verify-loop section 2); any doubt runs every gate.
After a fix, the rerun table (verify-loop section 2) limits gates 4-6 to what the fix touched; gates 2, 3 and 7 always rerun.
Never make a gate green by weakening it: no skipped or retried tests, raised timeouts, lint disables or deleted checks.
A SKIP on a gate the change needs is a FAIL; a DEFER names who runs the gate and where its result will be.
The same mistake corrected twice becomes a project check in .agents/checks/ (checks.py new <id>).
example: pnpm typecheck (exit 0); pnpm lint (exit 0); pnpm --filter web test (212 passed)
billing.test.ts "keeps paid invoice unlocked" fails with the fix reverted
e2e/reports/WEST-12-...json at a1b2c3d, no AC path touched since
AC1 test, AC2 test, AC3 e2e step 4

harness-map.when: Setup audit: what is installed, missing or failing, as one HTML page

project-init.when: Repo has no agent block yet, or a doctor run (scripts/doctor.py)

environments.when: Before any deploy, SSH, migration or remote data access

worktree-flow.when: Before the first file change (own worktree) and when finishing (PR into the integration branch)

feature-build.when: /feature-build or a user story to implement, in an S, M or L lane

bug-triage.when: /bug-triage or a bug or QA ticket

fe-guardrails.when: Before writing React or Next.js screens, forms and error states

ask-or-decide.when: Before an AskUserQuestion call or a scope change

axi.when: While building a CLI that agents will call

server-touch.when: Before a Bash call that touches a live Docker Compose host

root-cause.when: A test, build or deploy fails, or a fix did not work

verify-loop.when: Before calling a change done or opening a PR: every gate in order on one head, loop back on red, one PASS/FAIL table

chrome-devtools-axi.when: The browser driver behind e2e-verify when Playwright MCP is absent

e2e-verify.when: Before calling a user-facing change done: browser evidence per AC

flow-trace.when: Before done on state machines, webhooks, jobs, money, access gates

security-pass.when: Before done when the diff hits auth, entry points, tenant data, privileged clients, SQL, storage, env, raw HTML

fresh-review.when: Before a PR: a fresh subagent reviews the diff until clean

gnhf.when: /gnhf overnight loop of small committed changes

logging-standard.when: Before writing code that logs or changing a logger: one field contract, redaction, correlation

betterstack-logs.when: Reading a deployed environment's log history while debugging, or setting up shipping to Better Stack

jira-bug-hunter.when: /jira-bug-hunter: assigned Jira bugs one at a time in the main session, until fixed, merged, verified on dev and demoed

feature-status.when: In a repo with docs/status/: claim the ticket on the remote before the worktree, record each AC tier as it passes, set in-review before the PR; the guard hook keeps status files script-only and ticket branches claimed

stow.when: Before a context reset or a break: save what was learned

knowledge-placement.when: Before editing AGENTS.md or a skill; red/green skill tests use fresh subagents
